lines.text: Many learners say: I have a lot friends.
Better: I have a lot of friends.
A lot of! She has a lot of books.

data.right: I have a lot of friends.

native.tip: “Nhiều bạn” trong tiếng Việt không cần từ nối, nhưng tiếng Anh cần “of” trong “a lot of”.
native.caption: Bạn có hay nói “I have a lot friends.” không? 👫 Phải nói đủ “a lot of”: “I have a lot of friends.” Nghe thầy Carlos đọc rồi lặp lại nhé! Luyện thêm trong app Lexkite.
native.comment: Đáp án: “a lot of.” Hãy nói to một câu bắt đầu bằng “I have a lot of…” nhé. Luyện thêm miễn phí tại đây: {link}

en.tip: Vietnamese needs no extra word, but English needs “of” in “a lot of”.
en.caption: Do you often say this? “I have a lot friends.” Say the whole phrase, “a lot of”: “I have a lot of friends.” Listen to Carlos read it, then repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
